precondition: One exact HarmoniousUnionArtifactSourcePacket and digest, one exact content-valid provider-local NotebookLMSourceReconciliationReceipt ID, and the exact NotebookLM Offer, invocation, and result chain whose source byte digests bind that packet and whose provider-local completion journal witnesses the invocation digest and result ID.
move: The owning NotebookLM provider resolves its receipt and completion witness, recomputes the source-packet-to-generation chain, reads only the provider-confined artifact bytes, validates MP3 signature, length, digest, media type, and bindings, then removes the path from the returned codomain.
